# NEUD Alpha v0.3.0 UI color palette baseline

Rollback reference for the v0.3.1 color-only refresh.

**Scope:** CSS custom properties and color-related values only. Restoring this baseline must not undo unrelated v0.3.1 bug fixes.

## Rollback

1. Restore the `:root` block in `src/app/globals.css` to the table above.
2. Restore splash shell colors in `desktop/src/app/splash-window.ts` if changed.
3. Remove any v0.3.1-only accent tokens (`--accent`, etc.) if present.
4. Do **not** revert unrelated TS/C++/layout fixes from the same branch.

See also: [v0.3.1-color-refresh.md](./v0.3.1-color-refresh.md).
